role: runtime Cython/C build service — it compiles and loads code the caller supplies

maintenance_set.principle: A document that describes what a script can check should be replaced by the script; one that records why cannot be.

position: FULLY INDEPENDENT - imports no sibling submodule and none imports it (verified by AST)
unusual_dependency: not on code but on a TOOLCHAIN (Cython + a C compiler) and on caller-supplied SOURCE
governing_rule: Never let an operation succeed on unvalidated input, and never leave a resource in a state the next process cannot reason about.
historical_defect: A non-blocking lock probe with timeout_s=0 DESTROYED live locks held by other processes - a probe that answered its question by breaking the thing it asked about. Invisible to any single-process test.

open_findings.title: `__pycache__/` ships in the source tree
open_findings.evidence: observation O-6 from the Corpus campaign; third submodule found carrying it (corpus, _cli, cython)

open_findings.title: `_builder.py` is 2 097 lines and constructs compiler subprocess arguments
open_findings.evidence: largest module; size and trust boundary coincide
open_findings.fix: split argument construction (pure) from subprocess invocation (effectful)

open_findings.title: The security gate's permitted-source rules are not published
open_findings.evidence: users discover the boundary by hitting it; _security.py + the strict suite define it in code only

open_findings.title: Toolchain flags may not all be covered by pins
open_findings.evidence: _pins.py exists for reproducibility; whether coverage is complete is unestablished
open_findings.fix: audit; an unpinned flag breaks reproducibility silently

open_findings.title: A green suite does not prove interprocess correctness
open_findings.evidence: the known historical defect - a probe destroying another process's lock - is invisible to single-process tests. test__interprocess_exclusivity.py and test__gc_coordination.py cover two cases; stale-lock-after-kill and cross-toolchain reproducibility are open

unverified_claims: the security gate cannot be bypassed by an untested source shape
no stale lock survives an abnormally terminated process
strengths_to_preserve: OPERATIONS.md and DEV_NOTES.md are TESTED against the code (test__operations_docs, test__maintainer_docs)
templates are treated as test inputs, not documentation
